proposal.explanation: Both source rows (A-003 with source_id L200 and B-002 with source_id F900) map to the same economic_deal_id D200 per current Deal Register links LINK-A-L200 and LINK-B-F900 dated 2025-09-30 (snapshot date). Amounts agree at 50,000 INR. Per P-DEAL-1, different source identifiers representing the same economic deal can be reconciled when links confirm identical economic_deal_id and amounts match. No timing discrepancy exists because booking and settlement dates (2025-09-20) are before the snapshot. All exposure is explained; zero unresolved on both sides.

case.question: The balances agree, but the identifiers do not match. Can the source rows be reconciled as the same exposure?

evidence_snapshot.population_scope: Complete supplied A/B populations for this fictional case and snapshot.

rules.text:
Snapshot recognition procedure | version 1
P-TIMING-1: Recognition dates
For this fictional control, System A includes an exposure from its booking date.
System B includes the exposure from its settlement date. Both snapshots include
eligible dates on or before the snapshot date. A transaction booked by the cutoff
but settling after it can therefore appear only in A.

Snapshot recognition procedure | version 1
P-TIMING-2: Required timing evidence
A timing explanation requires the A record, the missing B population, and a
current settlement-event record confirming PENDING at the cutoff with the same
source ID, amount and scheduled settlement date. Dates in A alone are insufficient.
Report the signed A-minus-B difference. Explain it as timing without changing
records or claiming the future settlement has already occurred.

Economic deal matching procedure | version 1
P-DEAL-1: Alternate identifiers
Different source identifiers can represent the same exposure. To reconcile them,
retrieve current Deal Register links for both source system/identifier pairs.
Both links must confirm the same economic_deal_id, and the amounts must agree.
The link date must equal the case snapshot date. Cite both link IDs and source rows.

Economic deal matching procedure | version 1
P-DEAL-2: Misleading similarities
Matching customer names, amounts, dates or total balances can identify candidates
but cannot establish deal identity. If authoritative links confirm different deals,
the proposed same-exposure match is invalid. Preserve both unmatched exposures
and escalate to a human to establish the actual population issue.

Evidence and disposition procedure | version 1
P-EVIDENCE-1: Evidence states
Record observable facts and current source references. Distinguish missing evidence
from contradictory evidence. If an essential lookup is absent or unavailable,
escalate with the missing item identified; do not invent it.

Evidence and disposition procedure | version 1
P-EVIDENCE-2: Amounts and reconciliation
Calculate balances in code. balance_difference_inr is A total minus B total.
unresolved_a_inr and unresolved_b_inr are the amounts of source rows still
unexplained after supported matches or timing explanations. Never substitute a
zero net balance difference for successful record-level reconciliation.
disposition is EXPLAINED or ESCALATE. EXPLAINED requires zero unresolved exposure
on both sides and current support for every proposed explanation.

Evidence and disposition procedure | version 1
P-EVIDENCE-3: Human action
The prototype explains and recommends. It does not edit source transactions.
A human-review pause records the reviewer's decision and next action. Resuming
the workflow cannot silently convert an unresolved case to an explained case.

note: Implemented v1 checks do not prove unrestricted prose/citation support. Human review remains required.
